summary: Held. Regulatory action confirmed: DRI searched the Delhi and Rampur offices on 26 Oct and issued seizure memos on 6 Nov under the Customs Act for goods worth about Rs 2.64 cr, in an industry-wide review of Scotch imports under the India-UK trade deal (NSE Regulation 30 filings, 27 Oct and 10 Nov 2026). The company says no material impact, but the inquiry is open. My 6 Nov Buy missed the 27 Oct disclosure. No adds. Tags: reason=filing; attention=no
